prompt:
Generate one standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese article illustration.

Visual DNA:
Pure white background. Minimalist black hand-drawn line art. Slightly wobbly pen lines. Lots of empty white space. Sparse red/orange/blue handwritten Chinese annotations. Clean absurd product-sketch feeling. No gradients, no shadows, no paper texture, no complex background, no commercial vector style, no PPT infographic look, no cute mascot poster, no children's illustration, no realistic UI.

Recurring IP character required:
小黑, a small solid-black cat with white dot eyes, simple pointed ears, a short tail, tiny thin legs, blank serious expression, slightly uneven hand-drawn body shape. 小黑 must perform the core conceptual action, not decorate the scene. Make 小黑 serious, deadpan, and slightly bizarre, not cute or kawaii.

Theme:
架构规划决定了代码的底线

Structure type:
前后对比

Core idea:
好的架构师提前画图纸解决边缘隐患，平庸的只顾着低头敲代码。

Composition:
左侧一个小黑，表情严肃，手里拿着一张极长且画满线路的图纸，并且用钳子正在剪断一个地雷的引线；右侧另一个小黑闭着眼睛，疯狂地在键盘上打字，汗滴飞溅。

Suggested elements:
超长线路图纸 / 圆球地雷与钳子 / 机械键盘 / 盲目的汗滴

Chinese handwritten labels:
图纸排雷 / 盲目敲砖

Color use:
Black for main line art and 小黑. Matte warm gold (#A07848, a deeper 筝弦金 optimized for white backgrounds) for main flow/path/arrows/key emphasis. Red only for warnings/errors/problems. Blue only for secondary notes or feedback/system state. Do not use orange; use the warm gold tone instead.

Constraints:
One image explains only one core structure. Keep the main subject around 40%-60% of the canvas. Preserve at least 35% blank white space. Use at most 5-8 short handwritten Chinese labels. Do not write a title in the top-left corner. Do not write the structure type on the image. Do not make it a formal diagram, course slide, or dense explainer.

Theme:
灰度发布的哈希分桶原理

Structure type:
系统局部隐喻

Core idea:
不管系统怎么扩容，原来分在名额里的用户绝对不能掉出去。

Composition:
画面中央是一个倒圆锥形的巨大金属漏斗或网筛，小黑站在旁边，手里拿着带有用户图标的小球往下投。漏斗内部被清晰地分成了不同的格子（槽位）。已经落入左侧格子的球被牢牢锁住，稳稳当当。

Suggested elements:
金属漏斗网筛 / 带有圆脸图标的小球 / 固定槽位 / 稳固的锁

Chinese handwritten labels:
哈希映射 / 灰度槽位 / 状态连贯

Color use:
Black for main line art and 小黑. Matte warm gold (#A07848) for the bucket boundaries and the balls already in the bucket.

Constraints:
Keep the main subject around 40%-60% of the canvas. Preserve at least 35% blank white space. Absurd but functional style. No title in top-left.

Theme:
被遗忘的负向缓存原子炸弹

Structure type:
概念隐喻

Core idea:
为了挡住无效请求建立的空缓存缓存，在真实目标被建立时如果不立刻清空，就会变成业务的阻碍。

Composition:
一个带着锁的空盒子（代表空缓存）挡在路中间，小黑用力推开这个空盒子，因为后面地底刚刚长出了一朵新的花（代表新建的Flag）。小黑手里提着一把写着“清空”的锤子砸向空盒子。

Suggested elements:
空箱子 / 新长出的植物 / 锤子

Chinese handwritten labels:
空状态缓存 / 阻碍 / 及时清空

Color use:
Black for main line art and 小黑. Matte warm gold (#A07848) for the new plant. Red for the empty box and hammer impact.

Constraints:
Keep the main subject around 40%-60% of the canvas. Preserve at least 35% blank white space. Absurd but functional style. No title in top-left.
